# CORE-2318 · Lane 1: CLI help-surface staleness sweep (READ-ONLY)

## Verdict: NOT CLEAN — 9 finding groups (static source-vs-source; live `--help` runs still required)

> Validation limit (blocking clean verdict): the resolved tool contract for this lane is READ-ONLY with no exec capability (`read, gitnexus_*, ast_grep, intercom, claude-link`; `grep/find/ls`/shell denied). I therefore **could not run** live `xt --help`, `sp --help`, `sb --help`, or `sb help <group> <verb>`. Every finding below quotes **exact source strings** from the help emitter side and the contradicting commander-definition side with `file:line`, but per the task's own CONSTRAINTS ("Verify against live --help output, never memory") each finding still needs a live-output confirmation pass by a lane with exec. No edits, commits, or merges performed.

## Coverage enumerated

- Code call sites owned by CORE-2313 — deliberately not duplicated; only help/description/option/deprecation strings cited below.

## Findings (help string → contradicting shipped source; fix lane owns the fix)

**F1 — `help.ts:31` skipped step number.** Help emits `'  6) Manage old worktrees when needed:'` directly after step `4)` (`help.ts:23-33` CORE WORKFLOW). There is no step 5. Contradicting expectation: sequential workflow numbering; live worktree verbs exist (`worktree.ts:1268,1322,1370,1413`). Cosmetic but user-facing.

**F2 — `help.ts:41` Phase 4 teaches auto-install of `sb`.** Help emits `'      4. Machine       — install system tools (sb, pi, pnpm)'`. Shipped registry (`machine-bootstrap.ts:60-80`, `MANAGED_DEPS` id `sb`) sets `install: { default: [] }` with `manualInstall: 'sb is not published to npm: set XTRM_SB_BIN to a local @xtrm/substrate sb entry (or put sb on PATH); automated provisioning ships with the installer pipeline'` and comment "never auto-installed". Help implies `xt init` installs `sb`; ship fails truthfully and requires a local source. **Retired-flow teaching — highest priority.**

**F3 — `help.ts:46` `xtrm init` options incomplete.** Help emits `'    Options: --dry-run, --yes/-y, --global'`. Live (`index.ts:59-66`) defines `--dry-run`, `-y, --yes`, `--global`, `--prune`, `--substrate-dir <path>`. Omits `--prune` and `--substrate-dir` (the authorized local `@xtrm/substrate` checkout flag that F2's manual-install story depends on).

**F4 — `help.ts:~50-52` `xtrm update` flags incomplete.** Help emits `'  xtrm update [--apply] [--force] [--repo <path>] [--root <dir>] [--json]'`. Live (`update.ts:370-379`) defines `--apply`, `--force`, `--strict-registry`, `--root <dir>`, `--all-repos`, `--repo <path>`, `--json`. Omits `--strict-registry` and `--all-repos`.

**F5 — `help.ts:~53` `xtrm status` misdocuments.** Help emits `'  xtrm status [--json]'` / `'    Show pending changes for detected environments.'`. Live (`status.ts:37-40`) description is `'Show status and optionally sync target environments'` with options `--json` **and** `--check` (`'Non-interactive summary; never prompt'`). Omits `--check`; description diverges from live.

**F6 — `help.ts` docs subcommands omit `verify`.** Help emits `'    Subcommands: show, list, cross-check'` (PRIMARY COMMANDS docs block). Live (`docs.ts:152,155,193,284,347`) registers `show`, `list`, `cross-check`, **`verify`** (`'Verify frontmatter schema compliance and detect drift across doc files'`). `verify` is undocumented in help.

**F7 — `help.ts` SESSION CLOSE `xt end` omits `--dry-run`, hardcodes `origin/main`.** Help emits `'  xt end [options]'` / `'    Rebase to origin/main, push, open PR, link issues...'` / `'    Options: --draft, --keep, --yes/-y'`. Live (`end.ts:399-406`) options are `--draft`, `--keep`, `-y, --yes`, **`--dry-run`** (`'Preview PR title, body, and linked issues without pushing or creating PR'`). Live default-branch resolution (`end.ts:~439-447`) reads `refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` with `master` fallback ("avoids hardcoding main vs master"); help hardcodes `origin/main`. Live description says "link **beads** issues" (`end.ts:399`); help says "link issues".

**F8 — `help.ts` `xt merge` cites non-existent `--rebase`, omits `--override-authority`.** Help emits `'  xt merge [--dry-run] [--yes/-y] [--no-beads]'` / `'    ... (FIFO, --rebase).'` Live (`merge.ts:40-46`) options are `--dry-run`, `-y, --yes`, `--no-beads`, **`--override-authority`** — no `--rebase` flag on `xt merge` (rebase is internal specialist behavior). Help invents a flag and hides a real one.

**F9 — `pi.ts` doctor failure hint teaches retired flow.** `pi.ts` doctor action emits `'  ⚠ Some checks failed — run: xt pi reload'` (doctor block, below `pi.ts:285` description), while live `pi.ts:422` marks `reload` `'[deprecated] Re-sync Pi runtime; use xt update --apply --repo <path> (planned removal: v0.13.0)'` and the reload action itself prints `'xt pi reload is deprecated — use: xt update --apply --repo <path>...'`. The doctor's own remediation points at the deprecated command. Related minor: `help.ts` RUNTIME `xt pi reload [--yes/-y] → xt update --apply` drops the `--repo <path>` suffix the live deprecation string carries.

## Observations (not firm findings; fix lane to adjudicate)
- `help.ts` doctor blurb (`CLAUDE.md fragments, Cat B skills/hooks drift, runtime views, duplicate names`) omits live `doctor.ts` substrate/legacy-migration/Pi-packages/updates sections — narrowed scope, not a direct contradiction.
- `claude.ts` status probes `bd --version` (`'✓ beads (bd) available'` / `'○ beads (bd) not installed'`, below `claude.ts:166`): questionable post-substrate-first (ADR §§40/46) but `end.ts` retains a `bd` fallback (CORE-2307), so not flagged as stale.
- `help.ts` release-prepare note referencing `unitAI-dnmcg` vs live `release.ts` `sp script changelog-keeper` invocation — needs live `sp` evidence; noted as overlap-adjacent, not duplicated.

- 9 finding groups, each with emitter `file:line` + contradicting definition `file:line` + exact quoted strings above.
- Missing to close: (1) live `--help` transcripts (`xt`, `sp`, `sb`, `sb help <group> <verb>`, plus per-subcommand `--help`); (2) in-scope paths for the three skill-doc surfaces (both attempted paths ENOENT).
